about: [O6] The latency of a hit to its first frame (brief O6 §4; GAME_TWO §1 A1): a trusted LMB at a bin on the bed's east kerb, from the press to the first frame the bin is out of its place (Smash.detach draws it in the step the round lands). A car's hit is met inside the car's own step (Car.collide -> smash), so the thing moves in the frame of the contact. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6_latency.json

steps.check: D.round && D.round.ms != null && D.round.shotMs != null && D.round.ms - D.round.shotMs < 50
steps.label: the bin out of its place within 50 ms of the round that hit it (the press to the round is the gun kit's: printed)
